title: Building Search Applications with Elasticsearch
search_title: Blog: Building Search Applications with Elasticsearch
description: Explore how to build production-ready search applications using Elasticsearch and its ecosystem of tools.
body: Search is at the heart of modern applications. In this guide, we walk through building a search application from scratch. First, define your index mappings to match your data model. Consider using dynamic templates for flexible schemas. The Query DSL provides a rich set of operators for full-text search, filtering, and aggregations.
summary: Explore how to build production-ready search applications using Elasticsearch and its ecosystem of tools.
